description.en: Declare a schedule and let your Mac run your AI jobs through launchd.
description.zh: 声明任务日程，交给 Mac 的 launchd 定时运行 AI 工作。

source.description: Declarative task scheduler for macOS that runs AI jobs via launchd

description.en: A single mechanical stopwatch catches the beginning of a timed run. The complete ring, crown and short button remain comfortably inset around the broad face.
description.zh: 一只机械秒表定格任务开始计时的一刻。提环、表冠和短按钮完整保留，围绕宽阔表面留足余量。

description.en: Rich green enamel, satin steel and a brass crown carry the identity. Ivory hands and glass highlights are solid material, while both ring openings are transparent.
description.zh: 浓郁绿珐琅、缎面钢和黄铜表冠构成标识；象牙色指针及玻璃高光属于实体，提环两侧镂空透明。

description.en: An interrupted outer minute track, a shorter offset timing arc and grouped launch ticks on pistachio paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 浅开心果色纸面上的间断分钟轨道与分组启动刻度。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the emerald face and steel case remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认祖母绿表盘与钢制表壳；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Schedule shell commands, OpenCode prompts, and HTTP tasks on a Mac, then inspect their local run history and output through a CLI and Dashboard.
goal.zh: 在 Mac 上定时执行 shell、OpenCode 和 HTTP 任务，通过 CLI 与本地 Dashboard 查看运行历史和输出。

role.en: Development server and CLI API bridge
role.zh: 开发服务与 CLI API 桥接

description.en: An interrupted minute track, an offset timing arc and grouped launch ticks make time visible.
description.zh: 断续分针轨道、偏心计时弧与成组启动刻度，让时间安排清楚可见。

alt.en: Emerald enamel mechanical stopwatch on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 祖母绿珐琅机械秒表，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 把每一次运行，安排妥当。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥86px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 86px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
